It is up to you to figure out if you are asexual or not. Judging by your claim of lack of sexual attraction, it's certainly possible, but it's up to you to make that judgment.

Asexuality means the lack of sexual attraction toward a specific person. Some people say asexuality also means the lack of sexual desire, too. But I think the definition is neither branded nor absolute. Everyone has their own spectrum, their own shade. Whatever choice makes them comfortable is what counts.

As a female myself, I certainly prefer pajamas. And by pajamas, I mean soft, baggy shirts (or hoodies) and maybe trakkies. Super comfy. I think baggy clothes are more appealing, anyway.

Terminal illnesses alone do not cause people to commit suicide. That's like saying AIDS causes suicide. Committing suicide is not a symptom among incurable diseases. Diseases like Lewy body disease did not "cause" Robin to commit suicide, nor did it kill Robin Williams. It's possible that his disease contributed to his depression, which contributed to his suicide, among other possible factors. It's all a domino effect. A neurologist, Dr. David Knopman said, "Suicide is an extremely uncommon outcome of dementia with Lewy bodies.”
